payload.rationale: The simplest complete decomposition follows the irreversible delivery flow: first reconcile and preserve all substantive histories, then prove one exact remotely durable candidate, then govern merge/release/deployment/production verification. Separating these three capabilities prevents stale-SHA evidence and premature irreversible actions while avoiding duplicate implementation work. Existing executable Issue 60 can materialize this plan without creating new work items. Cross-capability order is strict: assurance depends on reconciliation; production delivery depends on passed assurance. Cross-repository BOS Goal 216 supplies coordination context, but the scoped repository and mutation boundary remain acancelas/symphony.

capabilities.title: Reconcile all substantive Symphony histories into one safe candidate
capabilities.context: Goal 59 is the Symphony repository portion of central BOS Goal 216. origin/main is d5c51b4b at immutable v0.2.1, while origin/codex/goal-216-consolidate-symphony and other local/remote issue histories may contain substantive work. Workspace safety rules forbid deleting dirty/unreadable/unpushed state, force-pushing, or overwriting unrelated changes.
capabilities.expectedOutcome: A single clean, reviewable candidate contains every substantive non-duplicated change intended for Symphony, preserves provenance, and leaves all unrelated or uncertain local state intact.
scope: Inventory local clones/worktrees, branches, tags, remote heads, dirty state, and commit ancestry
Classify substantive changes versus already-merged, audit-only, generated, duplicate, or unrelated state
Integrate required commits on the issue branch using non-destructive Git operations
Document provenance, exclusions, conflicts, and the exact candidate SHA
outOfScope: Deleting or pruning worktrees/clones/branches
Force-push, history rewriting, destructive cleanup, or overwriting unrelated changes
Adding unrelated product behavior
acceptanceCriteria: Every discovered substantive local and remote history is dispositioned with evidence
All required changes are reachable from one candidate commit without force-push or history rewriting
Dirty, unreadable, unpushed, ignored, or unrelated state is preserved and explicitly reported
Candidate worktree is clean and candidate HEAD is durably confirmed on its non-forced remote issue branch

issues.title: Inventory and classify outstanding Symphony histories
issues.context: Multiple Symphony workspaces and remote branches exist; some are older snapshots, some contain local config changes, and the consolidated Goal branch is ahead of main. Classification must be evidence-based before integration.
issues.expectedOutcome: A complete reconciliation ledger maps every relevant history to integrate, already present, duplicate, audit-only/generated, unrelated, or preserve-without-touching.
scope: Inspect Git ancestry, diffs, status, tags, worktree/clone identity, and branch reachability
Identify cross-repository intent from central Goal 216 without mutating those repositories
Record exact commit references and preservation decisions
outOfScope: Editing product code
Deleting, cleaning, resetting, or rebasing source histories
Creating BOS work items
acceptanceCriteria: Ledger covers every discoverable Symphony local/worktree and relevant remote history
Each substantive commit set has an explicit disposition and rationale
Uncertain or dirty histories are preserved rather than guessed away

issues.title: Build and publish the non-destructive consolidated candidate
issues.context: Uses the reconciliation ledger to integrate only required Symphony changes while maintaining upstream Symphony concepts and BOS specializations, including GameApiTrackerAdapter, durable audit/outbox semantics, repository serialization, recovery safety, and credential boundaries.
issues.expectedOutcome: One clean candidate SHA on the issue branch contains the complete reconciled product state and no unrelated modifications.
scope: Merge or cherry-pick reconciled histories with provenance
Resolve conflicts against current main without weakening contracts
Apply only strictly derived integration repairs
Publish candidate using guarded non-force Git transport
outOfScope: Force-push or rewriting existing shared history
Temporary compatibility contracts or scope reduction
Direct GitHub API/GraphQL access outside bos-mcp
acceptanceCriteria: Candidate includes all items marked integrate in the ledger
Candidate preserves GameApiTrackerAdapter-only BOS Delivery access, audit durability, idempotency, identity, rate-limit, repository fencing, recovery, and workspace safety invariants
Git status is clean and exact HEAD is reachable from the non-forced remote issue branch
Conflicts and derived repairs have targeted tests or documented proof

capabilities.title: Prove the exact consolidated candidate is releasable
capabilities.context: Symphony is a stateful Elixir/OTP scheduler with concurrency, recovery, subprocess, audit-chain, token-budget, and security-sensitive integration boundaries. Evidence and reviews must bind to the exact remotely durable candidate commit and restart if that SHA changes.
capabilities.expectedOutcome: The exact candidate SHA passes all required repository checks, risk-adaptive independent reviews, and functional/runtime/browser verification with durable BOS evidence.
scope: Run .bos/project.yaml required test command and the stricter nearby make all/spec gates where available
Exercise targeted reconciliation, outbox, Game API, Goal execution, delivery coordinator, workspace, cancellation, release and dashboard paths
Perform functional and quality review plus security and architecture review; visual review only if UI/dashboard changes
Record exact-SHA EvidenceReports and repair at most two strictly derived cycles
outOfScope: Waiving a required failing check
Treating evidence from another SHA as current
Unbounded repair or unrelated refactoring
acceptanceCriteria: cd elixir && mise exec -- mix test passes on the exact candidate SHA
make all and mix specs.check pass where available, with any unavailable check explicitly evidenced rather than silently omitted
Functional and quality reviews pass; security and architecture reviews pass for high-risk boundaries; visual review passes when rendered UI changed

Runtime smoke verifies daemon start/controlled stop, canonical Game API integration, and no leaked child processes; integrated-browser dashboard/flow verification runs when a browser surface is present
All evidence references the exact remote candidate SHA and any repair causes the complete affected validation/review set to rerun

issues.title: Validate and independently review the exact candidate
issues.context: The repository gate in .bos/project.yaml is mix test, while elixir/AGENTS.md additionally identifies make all and mix specs.check. High-risk orchestration and credential boundaries require security and architecture scrutiny in addition to baseline functional and quality review.
issues.expectedOutcome: A clean exact commit has complete reproducible evidence and no unresolved release-blocking finding.
scope: Required and targeted automated tests
Static/spec/format/lint/coverage/dialyzer gates exposed by make all
Functional/runtime and conditional browser verification
Risk-adaptive reviewer artifacts and at most two strictly-derived repair cycles
outOfScope: Changing acceptance criteria to fit failures
Reusing stale evidence
Product improvements unrelated to a release-blocking finding
acceptanceCriteria: All applicable required validations pass against one exact candidate SHA
No functional, quality, security, architecture, or applicable visual blocking finding remains
OS child ownership scan is zero after tests and runtime shutdown
Durable BOS evidence records commands, results, environment, artifacts, residual risk, and exact SHA

capabilities.title: Merge, release, deploy, and verify the exact revision
capabilities.context: GitHub is the delivery ledger and bos-mcp/game-api is the exclusive governed interface. Goal acceptance requires one governed PR, one immutable SemVer release, canonical-provider deployment, and exact-commit DeploymentVerification before completion.
capabilities.expectedOutcome: The reviewed candidate is on main, represented by one immutable SemVer release, running in the canonical production environment, and proven by passed exact-revision verification with rollback readiness.
scope: Create or recover the governed PR for the exact candidate
Require exact-head checks, reviews, and evidence before squash/approved merge
Derive one unused SemVer tag from the exact merged commit and create the immutable release
Deploy once through the repository canonical provider
Run concurrent provider, version, health, logs, smoke, functional, and conditional browser probes; record DeploymentVerification
outOfScope: Direct GitHub REST/GraphQL or gh usage
Multiple releases or deployments for the same Goal except a strictly derived governed rollback
Closing the Goal based only on issue/PR state without passed DeploymentVerification
acceptanceCriteria: Governed PR merges the exact reviewed candidate into main without force or bypass
One new immutable SemVer tag/release references the exact merged commit
Canonical production deployment identifies the same exact commit/release
DeploymentVerification passes all applicable provider, version, health, runtime, log, functional, security-boundary, and browser checks
On failed production verification, the approved rollback path is executed and verified before further promotion; Goal closes only after gateway-confirmed terminal projection

issues.title: Govern and verify merge through production
issues.context: This is the irreversible delivery stage. Merge, tag/release creation, production promotion, and any rollback must be exact-identity, audited bos-mcp operations with no direct provider credential exposure.
issues.expectedOutcome: Main, immutable release metadata, deployed runtime, and durable verification all converge on the same reviewed commit.
scope: Governed PR/check/merge operations
Immutable SemVer release reservation and creation
Canonical production deployment/promotion
Exact-commit production verification and governed rollback if required
outOfScope: Force merge/push or check bypass
Mutable/reused tags
Unverified production completion
acceptanceCriteria: PR HEAD equals reviewed/evidenced candidate at merge request
Merged main SHA is the sole release target
Production reports the exact release/commit and passes DeploymentVerification
Audit receipts cover merge, release, deployment, verification, and any rollback boundary

dependencies.rationale: Assurance must bind to the final reconciled and remotely durable candidate.
No merge, immutable release, or production deployment may begin until exact-candidate validations, reviews, and evidence pass.

risks.mitigation: Inventory and preserve dirty/unpushed/unreadable histories; prohibit force-push, reset, deletion, and destructive cleanup.
Provenance ledger, targeted conflict tests, full gates, independent functional/quality/architecture reviews, and exact-SHA evidence.
Use bos-mcp/game-api exclusively for Delivery state and provider operations; retain host-side secrets and command-policy denial of direct GitHub access.
Validate repository fencing, shared rate-limit circuits, immutable claim identity, outbox hash/watermark recovery, test isolation, and subprocess reaping.
Bind PR checks, evidence, merge, tag, release, deployment, and DeploymentVerification to exact commit identity; fail closed on drift.
One governed deployment, concurrent production probes, observable rollback reference, and verified rollback on failure.
Treat central acancelas/bos-mcp Goal 216 as coordination context only; Symphony delivery remains repository-scoped and does not mutate sibling repositories.
